s: Encrypted vault for credentials/API keys/certs with rotation schedules and IAM-scoped access.
w: Secrets stored encrypted (KMS-backed), fetched at runtime via IAM-authorized calls; versioning tracks history enabling rollback. Rotation lambdas flip dependent-system passwords atomically (dual-value windows). Audit trails log every read. Caching layers reduce fetch rates within service quotas.
use: DB credentials rotated automatically without deploy cycles
Third-party API keys centralized with access audits
avoid: Config values that aren't secret (env vars/config services fit)
Hot-loop fetching (cache with TTL near rotation windows)
pits: Rotation windows breaking readers mid-fetch - dual-key overlap strategies
tips: Zero-trust framing: no long-lived creds in env vars anymore - fetch at runtime
